articles.text: PEDRO: Déjame presentarte a un amigo, Jaime Ortiz. Jaime está aprendiendo a jugar.
PEDRO: Let me introduce you to a friend, Jaime Ortiz. Jaime is learning to play.
VÍCTOR: Pleased to meet you, Víctor Blanco.
VÍCTOR: ¿Qué le parece el golf?, ¿le gusta?
VÍCTOR: What do you think of golf? Do you like it?
JAIME: Sí, aunque me cuesta mucho. Pero Pedro se ha comprometido a enseñarme.
JAIME: Yes, although it's very hard for me. But Pedro has promised to teach me.
VÍCTOR: Entonces no se preocupe. Pronto va a aprender. Pedro sabe muchísimo de golf.
VÍCTOR: Then don't worry. You'll learn soon. Pedro knows a lot about golf.
